official: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central Functional Consultant
audience: As a candidate for this exam, you implement Dynamics 365 Business Central. Candidates configure the core application, create companies, migrate data and collaborate with implementation teams to ensure useability and effective business management. Candidates implement and configure Business Central modules, including:

Candidates have applied experience meeting business requirements and may specialize in one or more Business Central feature areas. They configure role centers, including insights, cues, action tiles, reports and charts, and expand functionality by using extensions. Candidates configure and use Copilot capabilities in Business Central, including built-in agents.
They understand how to integrate Business Central with other technologies, including:

sections.title: Create and configure a company
skills: Create a company by using Assisted Setup
Create and use a configuration package
Migrate data to and within Business Central

sections.title: Manage security
skills: Assign user permissions by using security groups and permission sets
Configure and use security auditing in Business Central

sections.title: Set up core functionality
skills: Set up reports and configure report layouts
Set up and use job queues

sections.title: Set up dimensions
skills: Set up dimensions and dimension values
Set up global dimensions and shortcut dimensions
Set up default dimensions for master data
Set up blocking combinations of dimensions and dimension values
Set up default dimensions for account types

sections.title: Manage approvals by using workflows
skills: Set up users for approval and workflow user groups

sections.title: Manage the chart of accounts
skills: Prepare financial reporting with financial data and account categories

sections.title: Set up journals and bank accounts
skills: Create journal templates, including number series

sections.title: Set up accounts payables
skills: Create vendor accounts, including payment terms, vendor bank accounts, and related records
Assess the relationship between vendors, vendor ledger entries, detailed vendor ledger entries, and general ledger entries

sections.title: Set up accounts receivables
skills: Create customer accounts, including payment terms, payment methods, customer bank accounts, and related records
Assess the relationship between customers, customer ledger entries, detailed customer ledger entries, and general ledger entries

sections.title: Configure fixed assets
skills: Configure fixed asset settings, including depreciation books and fixed asset classes and subclasses
Create and modify fixed assets, main assets, and components

sections.title: Set up inventory
skills: Configure core item settings, including item categories, item attributes, units of measure, and item variants
Assess the relationship between items, item ledger entries, value entries, and general ledger entries

sections.title: Configure master data for sales and purchasing
skills: Configure core customer settings including shipping agents, locations, and shipping addresses
Configure core vendor settings including order address, lead time, and locations

sections.title: Manage pricing and discounts
skills: Manage purchase line and invoice discounts
Manage sales line and invoice discounts

sections.title: Perform basic tasks in Business Central
skills: Differentiate between designing, customizing, and personalizing pages
Perform data updates by using the Edit in Excel feature
Configure and use data analysis mode

sections.title: Process purchases
skills: Receive items for a purchase order
Create a posted invoice from a purchase order

sections.title: Process sales
skills: Convert a sales quote into a sales order or sales invoice
Ship items for a sales order
Create a sales invoice from a sales order

sections.title: Process financial documents
skills: Combine sales shipments into a single sales invoice
Combine purchase receipts into a single purchase invoice
Process prepayment invoices for purchases and sales

sections.title: Process journals and payments
skills: Process payments by using payment journals
Process receipts by using the cash receipt journal
Apply ledger entries and undo applied entries
Process recurring transactions by using the recurring journals
Correct posted dimensions using the Dimension Correction Tool
